parameters.query:
ALTER TABLE human_handoff_tasks
    DROP CONSTRAINT IF EXISTS human_handoff_tasks_source_type_check;

ALTER TABLE human_handoff_tasks
    ADD CONSTRAINT human_handoff_tasks_source_type_check
    CHECK (
        source_type IN (
            'appointment_confirmation',
            'disruption_case',
            'waitlist_offer',
            'appointment',
            'medication_case',
            'manual'
        )
    );

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS medication_support_cases (
    id BIGSERIAL PRIMARY KEY,

    clinic_id BIGINT NOT NULL
        REFERENCES clinics(id)
        ON DELETE CASCADE,

    patient_id BIGINT NOT NULL
        REFERENCES patients(id)
        ON DELETE CASCADE,

    appointment_id BIGINT NOT NULL
        REFERENCES appointments(id)
        ON DELETE CASCADE,

    medication_name TEXT,

    issue_type TEXT NOT NULL
        CHECK (
            issue_type IN (
                'how_to_take',
                'missed_dose',
                'side_effect',
                'allergy_suspected',
                'wrong_dose',
                'interaction_question',
                'refill_request',
                'other'
            )
        ),

    patient_message TEXT NOT NULL,

    symptom_severity INTEGER
        CHECK (
            symptom_severity IS NULL
            OR symptom_severity BETWEEN 0 AND 10
        ),

    has_breathing_difficulty BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT FALSE,
    has_face_lip_tongue_swelling BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT FALSE,
    has_fainting_or_seizure BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT FALSE,
    has_chest_pain BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT FALSE,
    overdose_possible BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT FALSE,
    has_severe_bleeding BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT FALSE,

    operational_risk_level TEXT NOT NULL
        CHECK (
            operational_risk_level IN (
                'low',
                'medium',
                'high',
                'urgent'
            )
        ),

    needs_human_review BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT TRUE,

    source_channel TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'whatsapp'
        CHECK (
            source_channel IN (
                'whatsapp',
                'sms',
                'phone',
                'telegram',
                'web',
                'manual'
            )
        ),

    consent_to_contact BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT FALSE,

    status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'new'
        CHECK (
            status IN (
                'new',
                'in_review',
                'awaiting_patient',
                'escalated',
                'resolved',
                'closed'
            )
        ),

    handoff_task_id BIGINT
        REFERENCES human_handoff_tasks(id)
        ON DELETE SET NULL,

    assigned_to TEXT,

    response_to_patient TEXT,
    resolution_note TEXT,

    created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW(),
    updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW(),
    resolved_at TIMESTAMPTZ
);

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_medication_cases_active
    ON medication_support_cases(
        status,
        operational_risk_level,
        created_at
    )
    WHERE status IN (
        'new',
        'in_review',
        'awaiting_patient',
        'escalated'
    );

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_medication_cases_patient
    ON medication_support_cases(
        patient_id,
        created_at DESC
    );

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_medication_cases_appointment
    ON medication_support_cases(
        appointment_id,
        created_at DESC
    );

SELECT
    TRUE AS success,
    'migration_completed' AS result,
    'ساختار مدیریت سؤالات و مشکلات دارویی پس از مراجعه ایجاد شد.' AS message;

parameters.content:
## فقط یک‌بار اجرا شود

این Workflow جدول `medication_support_cases` را ایجاد می‌کند و `medication_case` را به منابع مجاز صف انسانی اضافه می‌کند.

این ساختار برای ثبت سؤال، مشکل دارویی، سطح اولویت عملیاتی و نتیجه بررسی انسانی است.
